title: Finite scalar models under normalized integral realization
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a Noetherian scheme X and an internal module M over its continuous valuation-ring coefficients, IsConstantModelConstructible M [sk-def-sfb-constructible] is equivalent to IsCompletedConstantStratified of its ordinary completed section realization [def-sfb-integral-constant-model-realization]. This is a heart-level comparison, with no claim about completeness of complexes.

proof.text: Restriction along the point coefficient isomorphism preserves and reflects finite constant models. Apply integralSectionLocalModels to the absolute-value presentation.
Apply the ordinary completed constant-model transport to the resulting module. The composite is exactly the specified integral realization. Transitivity gives the equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Definition 6.8.10, Proposition 6.8.11(3), and the projection-normalized coefficient comparison; Stacks 099C, 099M, 09C1, 09C2 and 09AL as applicable.

theorem constructible_iff (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (sfbCondensedIntegers l E).X X)) :
    IsConstantModelConstructible (sfbCondensedIntegers l E).X X M ↔
      Scheme.IsCompletedConstantStratified X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal
        ((modulesFunctor l E X).obj M)
